name: sdlc-sessions
description: The skills that run a Claude Code session: /sdlc-recap answers where a session stands, in one fixed shape, with whether it can be closed; /sdlc-brief turns an issue, a spec or an idea into a Brief, the start of a Worker session; /sdlc-delegate makes the session a Lead that hands Briefs to Workers in herdr and relays their Recaps. It depends on sdlc, so a session keeps its guards.
